text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait's Interior Minister Sheikh Mohammad Khaled al-Sabah meets Bahraini counterpart.
- Trade volume at the Kuwait Stock Exchange declines on Tuesday's session.

- Parliament sends a bill that would increase pensioners pay to its financial committee for further study. The bill seeks paying Kuwaiti pensioners a monthly allowance of 50 dinars ($166) for every child born after their retirement from state jobs.
- Kuwait Investment Company (KIC) to launch a 25- million-dinar ($82.8 million) mutual fund.
- Kuwait to decide on the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) economic summit after it receives and invitation, Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah says.
- Parliament's financial and economic affairs committee to discuss state budget.
- New education strategy under way, senior official at the Education Ministry says.
